claim: Analysts say Oracle will reach 13 million customers next year.
summary: The claim asserts a forward-looking analyst forecast that Oracle will reach 13 million customers in 2027. Without browsing, tools, or provided evidence, analyst predictions about future customer counts cannot be verified from prior knowledge alone as of 2026-10-28.

sub_claims.text: Analysts say Oracle will reach 13 million customers next year
sub_claims.stated_text: Analysts say Oracle will reach 13 million customers next year.
sub_claims.note: No tools or evidence provided to verify existence, content, or consensus of analyst forecasts; forward-looking customer count prediction is not established in prior knowledge and cannot be confirmed without external sources.
